name: key_pillar
refs: the small black cat in a purple witch hat with a yellow star and bell, purple cape, purple eyes. Keep its design and face exactly, not comical
the thick pink and yellow marbled paint goo
desc: A thick tall pillar of sticky pink and yellow marbled paint goo rising straight up from a paint puddle on the floor. The small black witch cat is stuck to the top of the pillar, lifted high by its back, both arms spread out to the sides and bound at the wrists by strands of goo stretching from the pillar, like being crucified on a cross. The cat struggles with a distressed face. Goo drips down. Side view pixel art, same style, palette, outline and shading as the references. Transparent background.
